title: Definition of Done (applies to every story)

checklist.item: Every acceptance criterion in main.json is met, and the PR description says how each one was verified.
New logic has unit tests; anything touching an external service has an integration test (may be #[ignore] and need the compose stack). `cargo test --workspace` passes.
No `unwrap()`/`expect()`/`panic!` on non-test code paths unless the invariant is documented in a comment.
Public items have `///` doc comments; README/docs are updated when run steps, config or architecture change.
No hard-coded endpoints, credentials or tunables; everything comes from settings; secrets are never logged.
Errors are logged once with context (tracing); important operations have spans.
Work is on a feature branch named `story/<KEY>-<slug>`, merged via PR after review (/code-review), with CI green.
Story main.json status set to Done, task checklists ticked, and an activity entry added.
The PR description has a short 'What I learned' section (Rust concepts that clicked, gotchas hit).
